title: Introducing the Stem Cell ASCL2 Reporter STAR into Intestinal Organoids
author: Heinz, Oost, et al.
materials: •Ultracentrifuge, e.g., Beckman Coulter with SW32Ti rotorAlternatives: If you do not have access to an ultracentrifuge, you can also concentrate the virus using the Lenti-X ™ concentrator according to the manufacturer’s instructions (Takara, Cat. No.: 631231) with which we have limited but good experience.
Troubleshoot 1: Transposon-based STAR integration via electroporation
Troubleshoot 1: Transposon-based STAR integration via transfection reagent

steps.title: Revert mouse SI organoids
steps.instruction: Culture mouse small‑intestinal organoids in WENR medium after mechanical shearing; keep for 5–10 days until >80 % show cystic, highly proliferative morphology.

steps.title: Expand organoids & serum‑free pre‑culture
steps.instruction: Expand cultures for 1–2 weeks to obtain 5 × 10⁵–1 × 10⁶ cells. One day before integration, switch to serum‑free medium (no Pen/Strep, replace Wnt CM with 10 µM CHIR99021) for transfection‑based methods (B and C).

steps.title: Prepare media for chosen method
steps.instruction: • Lentiviral (A) transduction medium: standard organoid medium + 10 µM Y‑27632 + 8 µg/mL polybrene. Optional freezing medium: replace Wnt CM with 10 µM CHIR99021, add 10 µM Y‑27632 and 8 µg/mL polybrene. • Transposon (B/C) transfection medium: Advanced DMEM/F12 + GlutaMAX + HEPES, no Pen/Strep; replace Wnt CM with 10 µM CHIR99021; add 10 µM Y‑27632. Media are serum‑free.

steps.title: Set up required equipment
steps.instruction: For Protocol A: ultracentrifuge (e.g., Beckman SW32Ti) or Lenti‑X™ concentrator. For Protocol B: electroporator (e.g., Nepa Gene NEPA21). Ensure BSL‑2 compliance for all lentiviral steps.

steps.title: Produce lentiviral particles (A1)
steps.instruction: Day 1: Split HEK293T cells to 25–30 % confluency in a T75 flask or 100 mm dish, plate in DMEM + 10 % FBS. Day 2: Prepare transfection mix (per dish): 100 µL Opti‑MEM, 5 µL STAR reporter DNA (1 µg/µL), 1 µL pMDLg/pRRE (1 µg/µL), 1 µL pRSV‑Rev (1 µg/µL), 2 µL pMD2.G (1 µg/µL), 18 µL X‑tremeGENE 9. Mix, incubate 15 min at 20 °C (≤30 min), then add 127 µL to HEK293T cells. Day 3: Aspirate medium, add 8 mL DMEM/FBS to each plate. Day 5: Pre‑cool ultracentrifuge to 4 °C, prepare transduction (and optional freezing) medium, filter supernatant (0.45 µm) with a 60 mL syringe, load into ultracentrifuge tubes, balance, centrifuge 2.5 h at 170 000 × g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Concentrate and resuspend lentivirus
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, decant supernatant, keep the brown pellet at the tube top, remove residual liquid with a micropipette, resuspend pellet in N × 500 µL transduction medium (N = number of plates). Use 250 µL of this suspension (N/2) for each organoid transduction; aliquot remaining virus (250 µL each) and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Lentiviral transduction of organoids (A2)
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat water bath to 37 °C and pre‑cool centrifuge to 4 °C. Harvest 50–100 µL Matrigel containing ~5 000–20 000 organoids (7–10 days post‑passage) into a 15 mL tube, add ice‑cold Advanced DMEM to 10 mL, spin 300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; repeat if Matrigel remains. Resuspend pellet in 500 µL trypsin, incubate 3 min at 37 °C, then add 500 µL trypsin inhibitor (1:1), top up to 10 mL Advanced DMEM, spin 500 × g, 5 min, 4 °C. Discard supernatant, resuspend in 20 µL transduction medium, add 250 µL virus, spin RT 75 × g for 1 h. Incubate 1–4 h at 37 °C with loosened lid. Thaw Matrigel on ice. Spin RT 500 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 100–200 µL Matrigel, plate 10 µL droplets (4–5 per well) onto a pre‑warmed 24‑well plate upside‑down for 10–20 min. Add 500 µL organoid medium + 10 µM Y‑27632 per well.

steps.title: Prepare organoids for electroporation (B1)
steps.instruction: Day 1: Replace organoid medium with 500 µL transfection medium per well (200–400 µL Matrigel organoids, 7–10 days old). Day 2: Add 1.25 % v/v DMSO to transfection medium, incubate 2–4 h. Remove medium, collect droplets with 1× dispase (100 µL of 100× stock + 9.9 mL Advanced DMEM/F12), transfer to 15 mL tube, incubate 3–10 min at 37 °C to dissolve Matrigel. Top up to 10 mL with cold Advanced DMEM/F12, spin 300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; repeat if pellet not clean. Resuspend pellet in 1 mL trypsin, incubate 3 min at 37 °C to obtain small fragments. Inactivate with 1 mL trypsin inhibitor (1:1), top up to 10 mL Advanced DMEM/F12, spin 500 × g, 5 min, 4 °C. Optional count cells (aim 5 × 10⁵–1 × 10⁶). Pellet again, discard supernatant, keep tube on ice.

steps.title: Electroporate organoids (B2)
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat water bath to 37 °C, pre‑cool centrifuge to 4 °C. Resuspend cell pellet in 115 µL electroporation mixture (100 µL BTX solution + 10 µL STAR DNA 1 µg/mL + 5 µL miniTol2 transposase 1 µg/mL); transfer 100 µL to cuvette. Measure impedance, adjust to 30–55 Ω (increase volume if needed). Electroporate with: 175 V, 5 ms pulse length, 50 ms interval, 25 pulses, 10 % decay, ++/− polarity. Immediately add 400 µL Opti‑MEM + 10 µM Y‑27632, transfer cells to Eppendorf tube, keep on ice 10–20 min. Spin 500 × g, 5 min, 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in ~200 µL Matrigel, plate 10 µL droplets (4–5 per well) onto a pre‑warmed 24‑well plate upside‑down for 10 min. Add 500 µL transfection medium + 1.25 % DMSO per well for 30–60 min, then replace with 500 µL transfection medium without DMSO. Day 3: replace with 500 µL standard culture medium.

steps.title: Prepare organoids for reagent transfection (C1)
steps.instruction: Day 1: Replace organoid medium with 500 µL transfection medium per well (use 200–400 µL Matrigel organoids). Day 2: Remove medium, collect droplets with 1× dispase (as above), incubate 3–10 min at 37 °C to dissolve Matrigel. Top up to 10 mL Advanced DMEM, spin 300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; repeat if needed. Discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 250 µL trypsin, incubate 3 min at 37 °C to obtain single cells or small fragments. Inactivate with 250 µL trypsin inhibitor (1:1), top up to 10 mL Advanced DMEM, spin 500 × g, 5 min, 4 °C. Discard supernatant, keep cells on ice.

steps.title: Transfect organoids with reagent (C2)
steps.instruction: Prepare per well transfection mix: 50 µL Opti‑MEM + 0.5 µL STAR DNA (1 µg/mL) + 0.25 µL miniTol2 transposase (1 µg/mL) + 2.25 µL X‑tremeGENE 9. Vortex, spin, incubate 15 min at RT (≤30 min). Resuspend cell pellet in 225 µL transfection medium, add N × 53 µL transfection mix (N = number of wells), mix. Incubate 5–6 h at 37 °C with loosened lid. Near end, thaw Matrigel on ice. Spin 4 °C 500 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in Matrigel, plate 10 µL droplets (4–5 per well) onto a pre‑warmed 24‑well plate upside‑down for 10 min. Add 500 µL transfection medium per well. Day 3: replace with 500 µL standard culture medium.

steps.title: Selection of STAR organoids
steps.instruction: Begin selection 3 days after integration (or 7 days if viability is low). Refresh medium with puromycin 1–4 µg/mL and blasticidin 2–50 µg/mL (dose‑response test optional). Continue until negative clones are eliminated (≈3 days for puromycin, ≈7 days for blasticidin).

Protocol steps required for all integration methods are highlighted in blue.
